newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light at $103/dressed -private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light at $103/dressed -private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sales near midday Friday were light at $102.00 to $103.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, unchanged from the bulk of sales this week, market sources said.
About 700 head sold mostly at $103.00, they said. Most of this week's showlists were sold out, but those with cattle remaining were pricing them at $104.00/dressed and $64.00/live, the sources said.
The sales followed weekly movement of about 90,000 head, which kept most feedlots current, they said.
